newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session almost unchanged.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly down by 0.03 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.19 points, down from 446.34 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.01 million dinars against 1.03 million dinars over the previous session.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 0.34 dinar to 13.6 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat eased 0.28 dinar to 15.5 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.1 dinar to 29.5 dinars with 2,683 shares changing hands.
Insurance firm ASTREE rose 1.36 dinar to 24.38 dinars with only ten shares changing hands.
Most of the trade was on Banque du Sud with the exchange of 9,406 shares at the unchanged price of 10.65 dinars.
